fact: The paper states SiGIT, Mozambique's land information management system, had processed 1,375,586 individual parcels and 826 community delimitations in the national land cadastre up to March 2020.
The paper states SiGIT incorporated land legislation into its workflows for all land administration processes from registration to taxation, including transmission of rights.

The MCC evaluation brief says use of the land information system has largely not been sustained, and in many land offices it is not functioning or serves as a back-up database, with continued reliance on paper records.
